home.title: SkillSwap Mobile
home.hero_body: SkillSwap is your vibrant hub to share your skills and services with your community — unlock your potential, offer what you do best, and discover what you need in return. Whether you're trading for a service, a product, or turning your talent into income, SkillSwap helps you get the most out of what you're great at.
home.step1_body: List the skills you can offer and the services you're looking for in return. Be specific to attract the right swaps!
home.step2_body: Browse listings by category or use our AI Matchmaker to find potential exchanges based on your profile.
home.step3_body: Use in-app chat to discuss details and schedule your service exchange. Happy swapping!
home.no_listings_body: There are no service listings available at the moment. This might be due to a connection issue.
home.wishes_donate_body: Your generosity can make a real difference. Contribute to our community fund to help fulfill the wishes of those in need.
home.wishes_request_body: If you're facing hardship and need something you can't afford, let the community know. Post a wish and let us help.

definitions.body: The following terminology applies to these Terms and Conditions, Privacy Statement and Disclaimer Notice and all Agreements: "Client", "You" and "Your" refers to you, the person log on this website and compliant to the Company’s terms and conditions. All terms refer to the offer, acceptance and consideration of payment necessary to undertake the process of our assistance to the Client in the most appropriate manner for the express purpose of meeting the Client’s needs in respect of provision of the Company’s stated services, in accordance with and subject to, prevailing law of Netherlands. Any use of the above terminology or other words in the singular, plural, capitalization and/or he/she or they, are taken as interchangeable and therefore as referring to same.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and only collect data needed to operate SkillSwap.

collection.title: Information we collect
collection.body: Account details, profile content, listings, messages, device information, and usage analytics.

usage.title: How we use information
usage.body: To provide the service, verify identity, process payments, prevent abuse, and improve features.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We share data with trusted providers (e.g., hosting, payment processing) and when required by law.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can update your profile, manage visibility, and request data deletion through support.

security.title: Security
security.body: We apply industry-standard safeguards, but no system is 100% secure.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact support at support@skillswap.app for privacy requests.

community.title: Community Guidelines
community.intro: SkillSwap is built on trust. Please follow these guidelines to keep the community safe.

respect.title: Be respectful
respect.body: Treat others with respect and avoid harassment, hate speech, or discrimination.

safety.title: Safety and legality
safety.body: Do not post illegal, unsafe, or prohibited services. Follow local laws.

honesty.title: Honest listings
honesty.body: Describe your services accurately and avoid misleading claims.

reporting.title: Report issues
reporting.body: Use the report feature to flag suspicious or inappropriate content.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.body: Violations may result in content removal, account suspension, or bans.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This policy explains how refunds are handled for subscriptions and donations.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Subscriptions are billed in advance. Refunds are granted only where required by law or if a billing error occurred.

donations.title: Donations
donations.body: Donations are final once processed, except in cases of fraud or duplicate charges.

cancellations.title: Cancellations
cancellations.body: You may cancel auto-renewal at any time. Access remains active until the end of the paid period.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For refund requests, contact support at support@skillswap.app.
